summary: Verified the .pro-tape corner ribbon fix on https://rat-chase-idf.preview.emergentagent.com. Ribbon now renders as a clean, contained corner banner in the top-right of .pro-folder with text 'Confidentiel' (uppercased via CSS to 'CONFIDENTIEL'), clipped by the parent's overflow:hidden + border-radius:6px. No horizontal overflow at desktop (1440x900, diff=0px) or mobile (390x844, diff=0px). Ribbon is display:none on mobile as required. Pro section still shows the CLASSIFIÉ tab, RESTAURANTS heading, 4 list items and pro-cta 'Demander un contrat'. Hero regression OK (hero-lead, hero-call, hero-whatsapp, hero-devis present; no .girophare). Contact form POST /api/contact reached the backend but the upstream email integration (integrations.emergentagent.com) returned 500, so form-message got class 'form-msg err' instead of 'ok' — this is a third-party email service failure, NOT a regression of the tape fix.

minor.issue: Upstream integrations.emergentagent.com email endpoint returning 500 ('Internal server error'). Backend catches it and responds with error, causing UI form-message class 'err'. Not related to current fix; likely transient third-party outage.

integration_issues.issue: form-message shows class 'form-msg err' due to backend email integration 500 (external service). form did POST successfully.

action_items: Investigate emergentagent email integration 500 responses affecting /api/contact — surface a friendlier UI state or retry, but this is an external outage, not a code bug in the site.

Optional: the stop_h1 text check via querySelectorAll('h1') did not match 'STOP AUX NUISIBLES' as a single string (likely multiline/split spans). data-testid=hero-lead is present, so functionally OK; consider ensuring the exact text is queryable if needed for future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: .pro-tape fix is well-contained: fixed width 210px, centered text, rotate(45deg), parent overflow:hidden clips the ends into a clean corner banner. Good use of aria-hidden on decorative ribbon.
Mobile hides ribbon via @media(max-width:640px){.pro-tape{display:none}} — correct and matches requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the pro-tape fix and regressions; contact form failure is external

rca of the issue: N/A — original bug (ribbon overflow outside rounded corner) is fixed.
